deletion_rule: A chat is DELETE_CANDIDATE only when its unique actionable work, decisions, evidence and unresolved items have a canonical repository home. Conversation text is never the source of truth after migration.

voice_live: Preserve Sherpa-ONNX streaming STT direction and offline Kokoro/VITS-quality TTS goals, with multilingual IT/FR/EN/ES behavior.
Voice model downloads must support persistent partials/resume, coherent archive extraction and atomic asset validation; never save an archive as encoder.onnx.
TTS success requires audible playback, not only PLAY_BEGIN/native success; preserve audio sample/rate/RMS/buffer/routing diagnostics.
Live interaction remains incomplete; avoid auto-speaking responses that can crash, and keep user-controlled voice/live behavior until runtime stability is proven.
diagnostics: Cross-platform remote runtime parity PR #711 is merged and is the baseline for Android/Windows/Linux/macOS evidence.
Privacy-filtered Diagnostics -> PostHog PR #543 is merged; raw prompts/text/paths/credentials remain excluded.
Still require real-event validation of privacy-safe PostHog/remote Diagnostics on target builds and useful dashboards/incident correlation rather than treating merge as operational proof.
library_researcher: Library first-party candidates for ai.acceleration_backend and ai.local_inference now exist as discovered intake assets and must proceed through validation/security/certification rather than be rediscovered repeatedly.

Evolution work evo-a18f2c13c19927904ced0bbd for ai.acceleration_backend is claimed with acceptance gates implementation_tests_pass, security_gates_pass, regression_tests_pass and library_contract_pass.
Keep recurring Researcher needs-driven discovery, but require tangible intake/certification progress and preserve the less-binary experimental/validated/production maturity view.
airlab: AIrLab remains provider-neutral and subordinate to Cantiere project lifecycle ownership.
Durable external waits must use persisted WAITING_EXTERNAL/event correlation/watchdog/idempotency rather than keeping chats blocked.
Memory Fabric adds backends to existing memory; it must not create a second project/execution authority.
0 EUR/month and free-first/spend-safe remain defaults; paid fallback requires explicit authorization.
Web/PWA and Cloudflare are adapters, not architectural dependencies.
cloud_identity: For third-party app distribution, preserve per-user credential isolation/BYOK: no embedded owner API keys, no sharing the owner's quota, and no cross-user chat/memory contamination.
macos: Modern macOS and High Sierra legacy remain separate targets.
PRs #418/#420/#424/#441/#442 are merged for modern build/Metal/DMG/release/updater installer.
PR #443 updater lifecycle is closed unmerged; do not infer completion.
PR #444 High Sierra low-resource runtime/native shell is merged.
Remaining target acceptance includes real install/Gatekeeper/signing-notarization where applicable, sandbox-safe GGUF import, mic/voice, Keychain/BYOK and target inference evidence.
raspberry_pi: Raspberry Pi remains a future distinct ARM target rather than generic Linux.
Preserve planned autonomous-node role for phone/desktop/home/vehicle support and hardware I/O.
Preserve GPIO/UART/CAN/I2C/SPI integration scope, but start only after shared runtime/platform contracts are stable enough.
branding: A cross-platform icon/branding asset set was historically prepared for macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, Linux, Web/PWA and Raspberry Pi/ARM but repository integration was not completed.
